login.hero_subtitle: The modern, mobile-optimized accounting tool for small businesses and freelancers. Keep your data safe in your own Google Drive.
login.features_subtitle: Everything you need to manage your business financials without the overhead of complex enterprise software.
login.feature_dashboard_desc: Get a clear, real-time overview of your revenue, expenses, and net profit with intuitive charts.
login.feature_expenses_desc: Snap or upload receipts directly to your Google Drive. We handle the storage, you handle the growth.
login.feature_invoices_desc: Professional Hebrew/English PDF invoicing. Send beautiful invoices that reflect your brand.
login.feature_taxes_desc: Stay ahead of tax season with real-time liability estimates and deductible tracking.
login.drive_desc: We don't store your sensitive financial data on our servers. tbiz connects directly to your personal Google Drive storage. Total privacy, absolute control, and free for life.
login.built_with: Built with React 19, TypeScript, and Google Cloud Identity.

common.unsaved_changes_description: You have unsaved changes — discard them? All entered data will be lost.
common.sync_reconnect_hint: Your session expired. Changes are saved on this device — sign in again to back them up to Drive.

session.expired_body: Your Google sign-in has expired, so changes can't be backed up to Drive right now. Everything you do is saved on this device and will sync automatically after you sign in again.
session.expired_unsynced: You have changes that haven't been synced yet — they will be uploaded to Drive as soon as you reconnect.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Real-time overview of your business performance.
dashboard.progressive_tax_desc: Tax liability is calculated based on the official 2026 progressive income tax brackets.
dashboard.tax_period_estimate_desc: This estimates tax on this custom period's income only, using annual brackets. Review with your accountant before relying on it.
dashboard.custom_range_invalid: End date must be on or after the start date.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Manage and track your business spending.
expenses.no_categories_available: No categories available. Create one below.
expenses.drag_drop: Drag & drop or click to upload
expenses.receipt_load_error: Could not load this receipt. Please try again.
expenses.delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete this expense? Its receipt file will also be permanently removed from Drive. Receipts are subject to a 7-year retention rule — this cannot be undone.

vat.has_tax_invoice: Backed by a valid tax invoice
vat.has_tax_invoice_help: Only a tax invoice (חשבונית מס) with the supplier's tax ID allows reclaiming input VAT.
vat.supplier_allocation_placeholder: Allocation number on the supplier's invoice...
vat.supplier_allocation_help: Required above the dated threshold; without it the input VAT cannot be claimed.

invoices.title: Invoices/Receipts
invoices.subtitle: Generate and track customer documents.
invoices.prefilled_from_note: Prefilled from {{id}} — just choose a payment method below. All fields stay editable.
invoices.receipt_already_issued: A receipt has already been issued for this transaction invoice
invoices.delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete this draft? Drafts are not legal documents, so this can be removed permanently.
invoices.cancel_description: Issued tax documents cannot be deleted (7-year retention). The document will be marked as Cancelled and kept on record, retaining its sequence number.
invoices.cash_over_limit: Cash is capped at {{cap}} for this receipt (the lower of ₪6,000 or 10% of the total) under the Cash Law. Reduce the cash amount and pay the remaining {{excess}} by card, bank transfer, or digital.
invoices.payment_unbalanced: Payments must add up to the total. {{remaining}} still unallocated.
invoices.allocation_number_placeholder: Allocation number from the Tax Authority...
invoices.allocation_warning: This tax invoice is at or above the {{amount}} threshold and legally requires an allocation number (מספר הקצאה) from the Israel Tax Authority. Without it, the buyer cannot deduct input VAT. Obtain the number from the ITA portal and enter it below.
invoices.vat_treatment_exempt_note: Exempt sales are reported but do not support input-VAT recovery on related purchases. Confirm proportional treatment with your accountant.
invoices.notes_placeholder: Optional note shown on the document (e.g. payment terms, a thank-you line)...
invoices.refund_description: Are you sure you want to refund this receipt? The status will be updated to Refunded and the amount will be subtracted from your total revenue.
invoices.send_invoice_subtitle: Send invoice to your client by email or WhatsApp
invoices.scope_error: Gmail permission not granted. Please sign out and sign in again to allow email access.
invoices.send_error: Failed to send invoice. Please try again.
invoices.invalid_email: Please enter a single valid email address.

clients.subtitle: Manage your customer database and billing history.
clients.no_invoices: No invoices found for this client.
clients.id_number_placeholder: Business / personal tax ID for tax invoices...
clients.delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete this client? This will not delete their existing invoices, but the client will be removed from your directory.

bookingAgents.title: Lead Agents
bookingAgents.subtitle: Manage commissions and partnerships with lead agents.
bookingAgents.delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete this agent? Their associated commission records on invoices will remain, but the agent will be removed from your directory.

taxes.subtitle: Projected tax liability based on current performance.
taxes.income_tax_only_note: Income tax estimate only — excludes ביטוח לאומי / מס בריאות (National Insurance & health tax)
taxes.normative_description: Under the Esek Zair reform, 30% of your total revenue is automatically recognized as an expense for tax purposes without requiring receipts. Your actual tracked expenses are for your own business management.
taxes.estimate_warning: This is a simplified estimate. Consult with a tax professional for accurate quarterly filings and local tax laws.
taxes.export_subtitle: Generate a comprehensive PDF report for your accountant.

ceiling.approaching_title: Approaching the Osek Patur turnover ceiling
ceiling.approaching_desc: Your turnover this year is nearing the annual ceiling for an Esek Patur. If it exceeds the ceiling you are required to register as an Osek Murshe and start charging VAT.
ceiling.exceeded_desc: Your turnover this year has passed the annual ceiling for an Esek Patur. You are required to register as an Osek Murshe. Consult your accountant as soon as possible.

vat.title: VAT Report
vat.subtitle: Periodic VAT return (Doch Maam) for the Israel Tax Authority.
vat.patur_desc: An Osek Patur is exempt from VAT and does not file a periodic VAT return (Doch Maam). This screen applies to an Osek Murshe or a Company. If your turnover has crossed the exemption ceiling, register as an Osek Murshe and your VAT report will appear here.
vat.deadline_shabbat_note: Nominal dates shown. If a deadline lands on Shabbat or a holiday it shifts to the next business day — verify before filing.
vat.warnings_subtitle: These are legal blockers that affect the figures above.
vat.missing_allocation_desc: These tax invoices reach the allocation-number threshold but have no allocation number (מספר הקצאה). Open each one and add it.
vat.excluded_input_desc: The VAT on these expenses was excluded from the claim for the reasons below.
vat.suggest_monthly: Your trailing turnover appears to exceed {{amount}}. You may be required to file VAT monthly rather than bi-monthly — confirm with your accountant and update your reporting cadence.
vat.suggest_detailed_filer: Your turnover this year appears to exceed {{amount}}. You may be required to submit a detailed VAT return (PCN874). Confirm with your accountant and enable detailed filing in settings.
vat.cash_approx_desc: You report VAT on a cash basis, but no payment date is recorded. The period for these invoices was estimated — verify each one falls in the correct period before filing.
vat.advisor_note: Output VAT is recognized on a {{basis}} basis. Figures are guidance only — confirm thresholds, deduction rates and your reporting basis with a רו״ח / יועץ מס before filing.

profile.title: Business Profile
profile.subtitle: Manage your business information and document settings.
profile.identity_subtitle: These details will appear on your Hebrew PDF documents.
profile.type_help: This changes the legal titles on your receipts (e.g., "Tax Receipt" vs "Receipt").
profile.delete_confirm_desc: This will delete all data related to this workspace from your Google Drive, including all invoices, expenses, and receipts. This action cannot be undone.
profile.delete_verify_error: The confirmation text does not match. Please try again.
profile.incomplete_error: Please complete your business profile to continue using tbiz.

tiles.title: Your numbers at a glance
tiles.body: Revenue, Expenses, Net Profit and Est. Tax Liability update live for the selected period. Net Profit = Revenue minus Expenses; the tax tile estimates income tax on that profit using this year's progressive brackets.

period.title: Choose a period
period.body: Switch between Current Month, Current Year, or pick your own dates with Custom — every tile and chart below recalculates for that window.

charts.title: Revenue vs. Expenses & categories
charts.body: The bar chart compares monthly revenue and expenses; the pie chart breaks down this period's expenses by category so you can spot where the money goes.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.body: Use the shortcuts above the tiles to jump straight into creating a new invoice/receipt, logging an expense, or adding a client.

docTypes.title: Document types
docTypes.body: חשבונית מס (tax invoice) bills a client; קבלה (receipt) records payment received; חשבונית עסקה (transaction invoice) is a demand/quote — not income until a receipt is issued from it; חשבונית מס-קבלה combines both in one document.

statuses.title: Statuses & נפרע
statuses.body: Draft → Sent → Paid tracks the document's own lifecycle. A חשבונית עסקה never shows Paid — instead it gets a נפרע (settled) badge once a receipt has been created from it.

create.title: Add income
create.body: Tap "New Invoice/Receipt" to create any document type — pick a client, items and payment, and it's ready to send or download.

receiptFromTransaction.title: Turning a quote into income
receiptFromTransaction.body: From a חשבונית עסקה's row menu, choose "Create receipt from this" to auto-fill a new קבלה with the same client, items and price — issuing it automatically settles (closes) the source document.

searchSort.title: Find anything fast
searchSort.body: Search by document number or client name, filter by date range, and click any column header to sort — results are paginated below the table.

pdf.title: PDF & sending
pdf.body: Use the row actions to download a PDF or send the document by email directly to the client.

clientAndType.title: Client & document type
clientAndType.body: Search for an existing client or add a new one, then choose the document type. An Esek Patur business can only issue קבלה or חשבונית עסקה — a tax invoice requires Esek Morshe or a Company.

items.title: Line items
items.body: Add one row per item or service with a description, quantity and unit price — the total updates automatically as you type.

payments.title: אמצעי תשלום (payment methods)
payments.body: On documents that record payment, split the total across cash, digital, card or bank wire. Israel's Cash Law caps how much of a single transaction can be paid in cash — the field warns you if you go over.

datesStatus.title: Dates & status
datesStatus.body: Set the document date and, for a tax invoice, a due date. Status moves Draft → Sent → Paid as the deal progresses.

allocation.title: Allocation number
allocation.body: Above the Tax Authority's threshold, a document needs an allocation number (מספר הקצאה) from the ITA before it can be issued — this field only appears when one is required.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Add an optional note — it prints on the PDF, useful for payment terms or a personal message to the client.

add.title: Log an expense
add.body: Tap "Add Expense" and fill in the vendor, category, amount and date.

receipt.title: Attach the receipt
receipt.body: Upload a photo or PDF of the receipt — it's stored in your own Google Drive and linked to the expense for your records.

categories.title: Categories
categories.body: Pick a category to group spending on the dashboard's breakdown chart — you can add your own categories from the manager.

vat.title: VAT fields (Esek Morshe)
vat.body: For a VAT-registered business, each expense captures the input VAT and how much of it is deductible (full, two-thirds for vehicles/travel, or none for entertainment) so it flows into your VAT report.

overview.title: Your client list
overview.body: Every client you bill lives here, with lifetime revenue tracked at the top.

add.title: Add or edit a client
add.body: Add a client's name and contact details here, or from the invoice form while creating a document.

history.title: Invoice history
history.body: Open a client's history to see every document ever issued to them.

overview.title: What lead agents are
overview.body: If a lead agent brings you clients for a commission, track them here instead of as a regular client.

commission.title: Commission rate
commission.body: Set a commission percentage (and an optional minimum) per agent — log the commission owed as an expense from the agent's own invoice.

history.title: Commission history
history.body: Open an agent's history to see every deal and commission tied to them.

estimate.title: Income tax estimate
estimate.body: This estimates income tax on your net profit using this year's progressive tax brackets — it does not include ביטוח לאומי / מס בריאות.

deductions.title: Deductions
deductions.body: A qualifying small business gets a 30% normative deduction on revenue automatically; a Company deducts its actual tracked expenses instead.

disclaimer.title: Not a substitute for your accountant
disclaimer.body: Treat these numbers as a running estimate to plan around — always confirm your actual liability with a רו"ח / יועץ מס.

periods.title: Reporting periods
periods.body: Pick a bimonthly or monthly period to review — your filing cadence is set in your business profile.

report.title: What's in the report
report.body: Each period totals taxable sales, output VAT, deductible input VAT, and the net VAT you owe or are owed.

blocked.title: Blocked amounts
blocked.body: Some input VAT can't be deducted yet — e.g. no tax invoice on file, or a missing supplier allocation number — those rows are flagged so you know what to chase down.

export.title: Export
export.body: Download the period as a CSV to hand to your accountant or file yourself.

identity.title: Business identity
identity.body: Your business name, ID number and type (Esek Patur, Esek Morshe or Company) control the legal titles and rules applied to your documents.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.body: Running more than one business? Switch or create a workspace from the dropdown at the top of the sidebar — each keeps entirely separate data.

sync.title: Drive sync
sync.body: Everything is backed up to your own Google Drive. Use "Disconnect" here to sign out of sync on this device.
